title: Hanasato Minori — Watch Me Transform!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, everyone, it's almost time.
Are you all ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're ready over here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: More importantly, did you bring the video in question?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! It's right here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, we should be able to start right on time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, everyone!
It's time for another MORE MORE JUMP! livestream!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Finally!>
<I got so excited after hearing that all four of you would be here!>
<I'm so glad you're all together!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, a lot of people are saying in the comments that they're happy to see all of us together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone.
We've also been looking forward to this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's actually something we wanted to talk about together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How many of you guys watched “Walking with Minori” the other day?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That was an incredible episode.
She bumped into her friends and ran into a bit of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haha...
It ended up becoming a really, really long walk.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Seeing you in that dress made my day!>
<I liked how fun and chaotic things got.>
<Really? Now I regret not watching.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, like some of you just mentioned, that dress was pretty amazing. I liked how the flowers embroidered on her dress matched the accessories she wore.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. The stylist decided to include as many flowers as possible, since it's a part of my name...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, did they also pick out that really soft color for your dress?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I thought something close to a bright primary color would suit you really well, but your dress had such a grown-up feel to it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was worried the beauty of the dress I wore would steal the spotlight, but they took the time to find something that really suited me.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<A true professional.>
<You looked so cute, Minori!>
<And it was so you to have trouble walking around while wearing it. I really enjoyed that.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha... Yeah, I did have a lot of trouble walking around. I mean, it was such a pretty dress. I had to be really careful not to step on it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you ended up performing in that show while wearing it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! I got a quick break from work, so I decided to tune into “Walking with Minori.” I almost fell out of my chair when I saw you performing on stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, I missed the show.
I was in the middle of an interview.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was a great show!>
<Wait, what show?>
<I wish I saw it. What was it about?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Guess what?! I got special permission for us to watch it together, so you'll all get to see the show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: While we're at it, we should talk about what's going on to provide some audio commentary.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Really? Yes!>
<That sounds like fun!>
<Plus live commentary?! This stream's got it all!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As nervous as I am about hearing what you're all going to say, let's get the show started!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And play!

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “Deciding not to have a wedding before you even know anything about them would be such a big shame!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “That's why we're gonna give you a tour of the wide world of weddings today!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your acting's pretty good, considering you basically jumped in at the last minute.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Your movements with each line have that theatrical feel to them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Nene... Oh, the girl who played the lead gave me a bunch of tips!

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “I'll be showing you a live house wedding!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “A live house wedding?”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “That's right! They're weddings that involve singing, dancing and having lots of fun with everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “Just like a...”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I like how you stopped mid-sentence there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The truth is...
I forgot what I was supposed to say...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
I honestly couldn't tell.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That was a bit of a long pause, but I thought you were just building it up, since you were the last one to show her your world...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, does that mean Kusanagi's ad-libbing this entire part...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! That's right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She cleverly put together her lines with the one I was supposed to say and guided me to the part where I say, “I'm sure of it!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Nene!
You really saved the show there...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
We haven't streamed together for a while, so that was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. And everyone seemed to really enjoy the part where we watched Minori's show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have you to thank for doing such a good job of explaining what happened.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, “Walking with Minori” seems to be going pretty well, so keep up the good work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I will! I promise to work really, really hard so that it becomes a cornerstone segment!
